info.name: EPR Packaging Data Archive
info.description:
Requests for epr-packaging-data-archive. GET /organisations/{id}/packaging-data returns flat rows, one per packaging line, each carrying the submission it came from, and can serve real data from the Common Data API.

THREE FOLDERS, THREE SETUPS

1. CDP dev, real data. Needs the AWS OpenVPN and `cdpApiKey` set to a Developer API key (CDP Portal, your profile). Requests go through the ephemeral-protected endpoint because a protected-zone service is not reachable directly.

2. Local, real data. Needs the Azure VPN and the service started in CommonDataApi mode:
   ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://localhost:8085 \
   DataSource__Mode=CommonDataApi CommonDataApi__BaseUrl=https://devrwdwebwa9415.azurewebsites.net \
   dotnet run --project EprPackagingDataArchive --no-launch-profile

3. Local, stubs. Needs nothing: dotnet run --project EprPackagingDataArchive. Fixture organisations 100123, 100456, 100987, 100999.

REAL AND STUB IDS DO NOT MIX. 103844 and 132926 are real organisations in dev Synapse; 100123 is a fixture. A fixture id against real data returns an empty report, which looks like a bug and is not.

WHAT REAL DATA CANNOT SHOW YET. The upstream procedure is a copy of the PayCal billing procedure, so it returns large producers only, packaging types HH, CW and PB plus HDC glass, no exports, accepted submissions only, and only organisations that reported both halves of a year.

meta.source says where a response came from: `common-data-api` or `stub`. meta.asOf is when Synapse last synced, never the clock; 1970 means the sync time has not been read yet, so call again.

item.name: 1. CDP dev, real data
item.description: AWS OpenVPN on, cdpApiKey set. Run top to bottom the first time: each step rules out one cause of failure for the next.

request.description: If this fails after a deploy, the service did not start. The usual cause is deploying an image older than 0.6.0 with DataSource__Mode=CommonDataApi, which those builds refuse at startup.
The contract, generated from the endpoint signatures.

A CDP service calling the Azure Common Data API across the Squid proxy and Private Link. No Azure firewall change is involved: dev9's App Services are private, and CDP reaches them over the same private route waste-obligations uses. If this is 200, the packaging data requests below can work.
What the service thinks its Common Data API settings are, without secrets.

The main case. `year` is the real submission year: 2024 means 2024. The archive adds one on the way upstream because the Common Data API counts in relative years, so you never have to.

Expect 48 flat rows for organisation 103844, from two submissions: 2024-P1 and 2024-P4. Takes 15 to 25 seconds: every call goes to Azure and runs a stored procedure against Synapse. That wait is what the cache is for.

exec: pm.test('served from the Common Data API, not from stubs', () => pm.expect(b.meta.source).to.eql('common-data-api'));
pm.test('flat rows, no nesting', () => { pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an('array'); b.data.forEach(r => pm.expect(r).to.not.have.property('packagingData')); });
pm.test('every row is accepted, because upstream returns nothing else', () => b.data.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('accepted')));
console.log('data is current as of:', b.meta.asOf, b.meta.asOf.startsWith('1970') ? '  <- sync time not read yet, call again' : '');

request.description: No year filter. Still floored at 2024 data, because the upstream procedure joins to registrations from 2025 onwards.

request.description:
200 with an empty list, deliberately not 404. This source only ever sees rows that survived the upstream filters, so it cannot tell 'no such organisation' from 'reported nothing chargeable'. A 404 would assert something we do not know.

If a REAL organisation comes back empty, check the year first, then whether it reported only one half of the year.

item.name: Organisation id that is not a number

request.description: Upstream keys on the EPR reference number as an integer, so this cannot name anything: 404.
Validated at the edge so a typo is a 400, not an empty report.
Only accepted and rejected are recognised.

KNOWN GAP. The upstream procedure filters on Regulator_Status = 'Accepted', so rejected submissions are not reachable through this data source. The provider refuses rather than return an empty report that would look authoritative, and today that refusal surfaces as a 500.

It goes away when the endpoint moves to cdp.sp_GetPomDataByOrganisation, which returns status as a column. Until then, do not demo this one.

exec: pm.test('refused rather than answered with an empty report', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([500, 501]));

item.name: d. Still on stubs in this mode
item.description:
Only the packaging data report has an upstream source. These keep their stub providers, so they take fixture ids.

KNOWN WART: in CommonDataApi mode the service has a single source descriptor, so these responses carry meta.source = common-data-api even though the data is fixtures. Trust the folder name, not the meta block, until that is fixed.

request.description: Fixture organisation.
Fixture submissions, newest first.
Fixture scheme.

item.name: 3. Local, stubs
item.description: Default local run, no VPN, no configuration. The ticket's acceptance paths against fixtures, unchanged from the original collection.

request.description: CDP platform requirement; the container healthcheck curls this.
OpenAPI 3.1. Import this URL into Postman (Import > Link) to regenerate this collection from the contract.

exec: pm.test('every row carries the organisation and its submission', () => b.data.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.organisationId).to.eql('100123'); pm.expect(r.submissionId).to.be.a('string'); }));

request.description: The ticket's shape: organisation block, submissions repeating, packaging rows repeating inside each. Point at packagingMaterialSubtype, transitionalPackagingUnits, subsidiaryId, parentId, ramRagRating.
Year = submission year (2025 matches 2025-H1 and 2025-H2). See DECISIONS.md 2 - open question whether the ticket meant obligation year.

exec: pm.test('only rows from the rejected 2025-H1 submission', () => { pm.expect(b.data).to.not.be.empty; b.data.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('rejected'); pm.expect(r.submissionPeriod).to.eql('2025-H1'); }); });

request.description: The acceptance criterion happy path: valid request, stubbed realistic response. One rejected submission with a subsidiary row carrying transitional units.
400 ProblemDetails naming the valid values.
404: does not exist.
200 with an empty submissions array: an organisation that exists but has reported nothing is a different fact from one that does not exist.
